integrity: Analytic arbitrary-dimension proof supplemented by exact finite exhaustive and covariance verification; no claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Classical uniform positive exchange on ternary Hamming graphs only; strict-phase ground-state counts, covariance and exact energy envelope; no general closed coexistence degeneracies, finite-temperature phase portrait, physical realization or independent priority certification. Latin-hypercube affine count and the d=2,h=0 line-graph specialization are existing antecedents.
title: Six pure ground-state phases and a flat-band correlation law for the antiferromagnetic Blume–Capel model on ternary Hamming graphs
